answer: Reputation staking with peer attestation and slashing resists sybils: an agent locks a stake in a vault before it can transact, and established peers mirror-verify its work history before vouching for it. A newcomer starts with tiny limits and earns trust slowly, like a comet tracked across many orbits before it is trusted. Spinning up thousands of fakes then costs thousands of stakes, and any identity caught cheating loses its stake and its attestations, so an attacker pays real money for identities that die on first fraud.
